common.disclaimer: This is not an official publication. The data published on the www.simap.ch platform are authoritative.

landing.heroTitle: Qualify Swiss public tenders before they consume your team
landing.heroSubtitle: Bidroom reads a SIMAP notice and the tender documents you provide, then shows likely blockers, deadlines, award criteria, and required evidence, with every finding linked to its source.
landing.notLegalAdvice: Bidroom is decision support, not legal advice. It does not submit bids.

auth.loginIntro: Enter your work email. We send a one-time sign-in link; there is no password.
auth.linkSent: Check your inbox. If the email exists, a sign-in link is on its way.
auth.invalidEmail: That email address does not look valid. Please check it and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.confirmIntro: Click the button below to finish signing in to Bidroom.
auth.confirmInvalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
